title: Methali (Theme 5: Ushauri-nasaha)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child gives the hidden lesson of a methali on upbringing, not its words, and says when it is used.

floor.question: Haraka haraka haina baraka. Inafunza nini?

representations: a methali on a strip, cut in two halves
a literal and a hidden meaning side by side
steps: Ask what it teaches about life.
contexts: a story about a lazy child

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child says the lesson (teach a child while young) and gives a situation where it fits.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Methali "Samaki mkunje angali mbichi" ina maana gani?" Kwa nini "Samaki hukunjwa akiwa mbichi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Methali hutumia maneno ya picha ili kutoa funzo. Maana yake ni funzo, si maneno yenyewe.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Methali "Mtoto umleavyo ndivyo akuavyo" ina maana gani?" Kwa nini "Mtoto afundishwe angali mdogo" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kila methali ina funzo lake. Soma maneno yake kwa makini kabla ya kuchagua maana.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni methali ipi?" Kwa nini "Mtoto alicheza uwanjani" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Methali ni maneno machache yanayotoa funzo la maisha.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Samaki mkunje ___ mbichi." Kwa nini "akiwa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Methali husemwa kwa maneno yale yale: "Samaki mkunje angali mbichi". Tukibadilisha neno, haitambuliki.

checks.question: Maana ya "Mtoto umleavyo ndivyo akuavyo" ni?
